regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and ESI/CCDC footnote
regions.finding: The actual article title was captured from the heading. The abstract gives only aggregate scope/selectivity claims. The page states ESI availability and CCDC 1013803, but workspace SI association remains unestablished and no SI fact was imported.
Identity/context figure only; it contains no current-paper reaction arrow or preparative outcome and does not create experiment records.

Two distinct failed current-paper trials were retained: 1a/2a/(S)-3 with 0.75 equiv ZnBr2 or CdI2 in toluene at 130 °C for 16 h. Both give 0% isolated 4aa, while recovered 1a is 17% and 0%, respectively.

unresolved: The Scheme 1 workups and recovery analytical basis are not stated.
No SI association was inferred from the availability footnote.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left optimization prose and Table 1
regions.finding: All nine catalyst/loading/solvent rows were retained independently with shared 1a 1.0 mmol, octanal 1.4 equiv, (S)-3 1.2 equiv, reflux/16 h, isolated yield, de, entry-4 46% recovery, and entry-9 toluene override. The entry-4 de dash remains a source marker.

Eight aldehyde-scope rows were inspected. Table 2 entry 1 is the same standard-condition run as Table 1 entry 5 and is merged; entries 2–8 are separate. Footnote a gives 70 °C/24 h/40 mol% CuBr2 only for aromatic entries 7–8.
X-ray characterization supports the source assignment of (Ra)-4ae from Table 2 entry 5; it is not another preparation and does not verify the machine structure encoding.
The prose introduces the five Scheme 2 glycoside experiments displayed on page 3; cross-page evidence is linked without creating narrative duplicates.

unresolved: The numeric temperature represented by reflux is not stated.
Yield and de analytical bases, workups, purifications, and most isolated masses are absent from the main text.

regions.finding: Five separate propargyl-glycoside scope experiments were retained for 1b, 1c, 1d, 1e, and unprotected 1o. The 30 mol% CuBr2 footnote applies to 1d→4de only; the other shared conditions are RCHO 1.4 equiv, (S)-3 1.2 equiv, refluxing dioxane, 16 h.
The 1f thioglucoside run is one scope experiment. Scheme 3 contains two distinct 1g experiments at 20 and 30 mol% CuBr2 with 37%/98% de and 42%/97% de; they are not merged by product label.
Two separate disaccharide experiments 1h→4he and 1i→4ie were retained with 48%/98% de and 51%/98% de.

A distinct 0.5 mmol double-allene construction from 1j with 2.8 equiv BnCHO, 2.4 equiv (S)-3, and 40 mol% CuBr2 at reflux for 48 h gives (Ra,Ra)-4jb in 43%, dr >99/1, 97% de while leaving the acetal and terminal allene units untouched.

All five furanoside aldehyde-scope rows were retained independently. Footnote a overrides entries 3–5 to 70 °C/24 h/40 mol% CuBr2. The stated non-reaction at the acetal is chemoselectivity within successful experiments, not a failed reaction record.

The narrative introduces three distinct control experiments drawn on page 4: a 5 mmol gram-scale run, the opposite prolinol enantiomer, and propargyl alcohol 1y. They are linked cross-page rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Several complex carbohydrate structures remain source-label candidates with null SMILES.
Most scope experiments omit operational workup/purification and analytical bases.

regions.finding: Three independent current-paper runs were retained: 1a 1.9282 g/5.0 mmol to (Ra)-4aa 1.3199 g/51%/98% de with (S)-3; 1a 2.0 mmol to (Sa)-4aa 53%/98% de with (R)-3; and propargyl alcohol 1y 1.0 mmol to (Ra)-4ya 39%/83% ee with (S)-3.

Conclusion adds no new row. The acknowledgment says preparations of (Ra)-4ac and (Ra)-4de were reproduced, but supplies no independent conditions/outcomes; provenance notes were linked to the existing records without creating duplicates.
Bibliography and prior-work citations only. External papers and the partially continued reference 7 were not expanded into current-paper experiments.

unresolved: Acknowledged reproductions cannot be separated into independent runs from the available information.
Scheme 5 does not report workup, purification, or analytical bases.

regions.finding: The authors discuss inability to reproduce Periasamy et al.'s prior-literature yield/ee and suggest an HPLC issue, but no uniquely specified current-paper conditions or outcome are restated; no experiment record was fabricated.
Bibliography, source-preparation citations, and reagent-price note only; external papers were not expanded into experiments of the current article.

regions.region: page 5 reference 11 crystal data and CCDC 1013803
regions.finding: Crystallographic data characterize the existing Table 2 entry 5 product (Ra)-4ae. The deposition is not a reaction, not a second preparation, and not treated as an associated SI file.

unresolved: The page-5 reproducibility critique does not provide a separable current-paper run.
Crystallography supports the source assignment but does not certify the machine structure encoding or establish SI association.
